blocks.text: Eleven terms carry a specific meaning in this report, and twenty-eight documents support it, cited by the date on their covers.

Abbreviations are listed in the front matter. Deliverables are cited with the date printed on the cover; where the file date differs, both are shown below. Working analyses rank below the deliverables, and public sources are used only where no deliverable carries the figure.
